name: Completed SDSS-IV eBOSS cosmological implications
notes: The eBOSS paper summarises the whole SDSS lineage (SDSS, SDSS-II, BOSS and eBOSS), so the result is attributed to eBOSS (the completing survey) and not to BOSS or the SDSS programme record.

significance.quote: We show that the BAO data alone are able to rule out dark-energy-free models at more than eight standard deviations in an extension to the flat, $\Lambda$CDM model that allows for curvature.
significance.value: BAO data alone rule out dark-energy-free models at more than eight standard deviations (in an extension to flat ΛCDM allowing curvature)

summary.plain: The final cosmological analysis of two decades of SDSS spectroscopic surveys, including eBOSS. The baryon-acoustic-oscillation data alone rule out a universe without dark energy at more than eight standard deviations, and growth rates agree with General Relativity.
summary.technical: Combined SDSS, SDSS-II, BOSS and eBOSS BAO (eight samples) and RSD fσ8 (six measurements) constraints: BAO alone exclude dark-energy-free models at >8σ in a flat-ΛCDM extension with curvature; with Planck, BAO improve curvature constraints by nearly an order of magnitude; all multiple-parameter extensions remain consistent with ΛCDM.

title: The Completed SDSS-IV extended Baryon Oscillation Spectroscopic Survey: Cosmological Implications from two Decades of Spectroscopic Surveys at the Apache Point observatory
why_it_matters: The abstract states that the RSD measurements indicate a growth rate consistent with Planck primary-data predictions and General Relativity, and that all multiple-parameter extensions remain consistent with ΛCDM when SDSS BAO and RSD are combined with external data.
